title: tibouchina urceolaris
intro: Tibouchina urceolaris, commonly known as the Purple Glory Tree, is a species of flowering plant in the family Melastomataceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to provide health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in the treatment of various health conditions.
